            local isPlaying = false
            for _, data in pairs(toolData) do
                local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
                tool.Name = data.Name
                tool.RequiresHandle = false
                tool.CanBeDropped = false
                tool.Parent = player.Backpack
                tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                    if isPlaying then return end
                    isPlaying = true
                    task.defer(function()
                        tool.Parent = player.Backpack
                    end)
                    if currentTrack and currentTrack.IsPlaying then
                        currentTrack:Stop()
                        currentTrack:Destroy()
                    end
                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                    anim.AnimationId = data.AnimationId
                    local track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
                    track.Looped = false
                    track:Play()
                    track:AdjustSpeed(data.Speed)
                    currentTrack = track
                    local duration = track.Length / data.Speed
                    task.delay(duration, function()
                        isPlaying = false
                    end)
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
})

local function GetTarget()
	local now=tick()
	if now-tT<TR and tC and tC.Parent then
		local hum=tC.Parent and tC.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");if hum and hum.Health>0 then return tC end
	end
	local mouse=UIS:GetMouseLocation();local best,bd=nil,CFG.FOV
	local function Check(model)
		if model==LP.Character then return end
		local hum=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");if not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
		local head=model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");if not head then return end
		local sp,on=Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position);if not on then return end
		local dist=(Vector2.new(sp.X,sp.Y)-mouse).Magnitude
		if dist<bd then if CFG.WallCheck and not LOS(Cam.CFrame.Position,head.Position) then return end;best=head;bd=dist end
	end
	if CFG.TargetPlayers then for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP and p.Character and not IsTeammate(p) then Check(p.Character) end end end
	if CFG.TargetNPCs then for _,v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("Humanoid") and v.Health>0 and v.Parent and v.Parent~=LP.Character and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(v.Parent) then Check(v.Parent) end end end
	tC=best;tT=now;return best
end
